Filmmaker Zoya Akhtar Addresses Fan Abuse and ZNMD Sequel Update

Filmmaker Zoya Akhtar stated that she received abusive messages after a tourism campaign was mistakenly perceived by fans as a trailer for a sequel to her 2011 film 'Zindagi Na Milegi Dobara'. She confirmed that a sequel to 'Zindagi Na Milegi Dobara' is in development, stating "We are on it." Akhtar also clarified that Kalki Koechlin is not the villain in the film.
